record_title: Exact K_{2,4}-free Turán number for cographs
provenance: SCOPE Phase II research record. Review evidence is documented in REVIEW.md.
limitations: Originality is asserted only to the best of our knowledge. Small-order K_{2,4} data are present in the closest prior computational project, so the claimed contribution is the closed all-order formula, proof, and extremal classification. No independent validation is asserted.
